purpose: Give ClayCode parser/checker/lowering/runtime diagnostics a machine-stable identity suitable for fuzz deduplication, regression, negative corpus generation and later Harness differentials without binding semantics to human rendering or absolute source coordinates.

diagnostic_record.rule_id: Stable namespaced identifier for the semantic predicate/check, e.g. CC.TYPE.MISMATCH or CC.EFFECT.REVOKED.
diagnostic_record.rule_revision: Monotonic semantic revision of the rule predicate; changes only when meaning/decision boundary changes.
diagnostic_record.semantic_anchor: Canonical IR/node/resource/token-context identity when available; must exclude absolute path/line/column and other nonsemantic layout.
diagnostic_record.cause_signature: Normalized structured cause fields sufficient to distinguish materially different causes at one rule+anchor.
diagnostic_record.occurrence_fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical {rule_id, rule_revision, stage, semantic_anchor, cause_signature} for v1.
diagnostic_record.source_spans: One or more current source locations; evidence/display data, not occurrence identity.
diagnostic_record.message_key: Stable localization/rendering template key where useful; not occurrence identity.
diagnostic_record.message_args: Structured rendering arguments; not trusted as semantic identity unless also present in normalized cause_signature by rule contract.
diagnostic_record.children: Ordered or explicitly keyed causal/context diagnostics; preserve parent-child relation independently of rendered indentation.
diagnostic_record.suggestions: Structured replacements plus applicability/confidence class; separate from diagnostic identity.
diagnostic_record.instance_id: Run-local unique emission identity for repeated occurrences; never used as semantic fingerprint.
diagnostic_record.compiler_runtime_provenance: Exact toolchain/backend/run identity carried in receipt, not folded into semantic occurrence fingerprint unless the rule itself diagnoses that provenance.

anchor_fallbacks.parser_without_ir: Versioned token-context/parser-rule anchor derived from token kinds and parser state/rule, excluding whitespace/comments/absolute offsets unless those are semantically meaningful to that rule.
anchor_fallbacks.type_effect_ir: Canonical typed-IR node/edge identity plus rule-declared cause fields.
anchor_fallbacks.runtime_ffi: Semantic resource identity/epoch + operation identity + rule-declared normalized cause fields. Opaque bearer capability material must not be serialized merely for diagnostics.

required_invariants: Changing only path, line, column, whitespace, locale or rendering must not change occurrence_fingerprint.
Changing the diagnosed rule semantic revision must change occurrence_fingerprint.
Changing a rule-declared semantic cause at the same anchor must change occurrence_fingerprint.
Two simultaneous occurrences of the same rule at different semantic anchors must remain distinguishable.
Repeated emission of the same occurrence in separate runs may have different instance_id but the same occurrence_fingerprint.
Diagnostic identity never grants effect/capability authority.
A lowered/backend diagnostic may link to a source diagnostic fingerprint but must not claim cause equivalence if lowering has lost the evidence needed to distinguish causes.
not_required: BASE promotion from this candidate alone
next_falsification: Integrate as structured diagnostic envelope around current ClayError/checker/runtime paths, then run refactor/path/rendering/cause-mutation differential on the production Ubuntu ClayCode toolchain.
